source_title: Etsy Inc Reports First Quarter 2025 Results
snippet_primary: "Active buyers decreased 3.4% year-over-year to 88.5 million. We reactivated 6.5 million buyers, up 2.1% from the prior year period, and acquired 4.8 million new buyers. GMS per active buyer on a trailing twelve month basis for the Etsy marketplace declined 3.5% year-over-year to $120. The number of habitual buyers was 6.2 million, down 11.0% year-over-year."
subject_exact: Etsy's own disclosed active buyer, reactivation, and GMS-per-buyer figures for Q1 2025
metric_value_raw: 88.5 million (down 3.4% YoY); 6.5 million reactivated buyers (up 2.1% YoY); 4.8 million new buyers; GMS per active buyer $120 (down 3.5% YoY); 6.2 million habitual buyers (down 11.0% YoY)
